exact_recursive_identity.low_equation: dv_M/dt + nu A v_M + P11 B(v_M,v_M) = Gamma_M

recursive_stability_theorem.statement: For M,L>=11, ||v_M(t)-v_L(t)||_2 <= exp(C11||u0||_2 t) * integral_0^t ||Gamma_M-Gamma_L||_2 ds.
recursive_stability_theorem.consequence: L1_t L2_x Cauchy convergence of closure forcing implies C_t L2_x convergence of the fixed N11 projections.

observable_transfer.signed_numerator: finite polynomial J on the fixed N11 coordinate space
observable_transfer.sufficient_all_cutoff_condition: base negative margin dominates the Lipschitz-weighted sum of closure increments

no_go_results: Static F<0 or G_C500<0 cannot by itself imply singularity/local loss of smoothness.
Because G_C500(a)=G_C500(Pi11 a), G alone cannot control arbitrarily high-frequency vorticity, Sobolev norms, shell Reynolds numbers, or a determining wavenumber.
correct_regularity_architecture: fixed low-mode recursive closure plus an independent high-frequency dissipation/continuation criterion
next_gate: bound Gamma_{M+1}-Gamma_M by a shellwise high-frequency quantity with a summable or viscously absorbable budget
claim_boundary: No all-N, continuum regularity, blowup, or global regularity theorem is claimed.
